task_title: Ship the standalone CLI and the landlock loaders in the published wheel (pip users get a library with no jail command and an inert Landlock tier)
task_criteria: .venv/bin/python -m pytest plugin tests -q -m "not integration" exits 0 in the working tree
ruff check plugin/ exits 0 and ruff format --check . exits 0

Building a wheel from the working tree with uv build --wheel produces a wheel that contains terminal_jail-*.dist-info/entry_points.txt, and that file names a console script entry point called terminal-jail
Installing ONLY the built wheel (no source tree, no editable install) into a fresh venv and running the venv's terminal-jail --version exits 0 and prints 1.3.0

The built wheel contains a file named landlock-loader.py, and in that fresh venv an import of terminal_jail.interruptor plus a landlock tier probe reports a loader path instead of "landlock-loader.py not found"
python scripts/board_id_guard.py exits 0 and python scripts/docs-check.py exits 0
